scope: Authored Traditional Chinese / English engineering learning units; public principles, not proprietary recipes.

courses.title: 封裝寄生參數萃取
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入回流路徑、頻率相依 RLGC 與模型因果性；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine return paths, frequency-dependent rlgc and model causality. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。準靜態 RLGC 模型不能跨越明顯輻射或共振區間；需以電氣長度、全波結果與量測共同界定適用頻帶。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Quasi-static RLGC does not automatically cover radiative or resonant regimes; bound its band using electrical length, full-wave results and measurement.

stages.title: 回流與埠定義

stages.descriptionEn: Address returns and ports through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for plan de-embedding validation: Fixtures, connectors and probes add parasitics; uncorrected comparisons can falsely blame the die.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。建立 through 或已知校正件，分開治具誤差與模型誤差。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Use a through or known standard to separate fixture and model error. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：建立 through 或已知校正件，分開治具誤差與模型誤差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

假設回路 L=0.8 nH、電流變化率 0.5 A/ns，L·di/dt=0.4 V；L 的 10% 不確定度單獨造成 0.04 V 不確定度。這是集中回路瞬態估算，未含傳輸線反射。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate the worked example and vary L by ±10% to plot a voltage range. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

Assume loop L=0.8 nH and current slew 0.5 A/ns: L·di/dt=0.4 V. A 10% uncertainty in L alone contributes 0.04 V uncertainty. This lumped transient estimate excludes line reflections.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare cold and hot resistance and define an iterative convergence criterion. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.title: 封裝內去耦電容整合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入去耦電容、ESR/ESL 與反共振；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine decoupling capacitance, esr/esl and antiresonance. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。ΔV=IΔt/C 是初始電荷估算；有效電容、路徑電感與穩壓器響應決定真實瞬態，不能以標稱容量直接保證電源品質。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. ΔV=IΔt/C is an initial charge estimate; effective capacitance, loop inductance and regulator response govern actual transients.

stages.descriptionEn: Address charge and impedance needs through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. steps.check: 交付「界定負載電荷」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.instruction:

假設 1 A 負載維持 2 ns 且只容許 20 mV 電容放電，C≥100 nF；若有效容量僅標稱的 60%，標稱值至少 167 nF。未含 ESL 過衝與控制迴路。

knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the 100 nF example, double pulse duration and check the change in ΔV. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限
knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設 1 A 負載維持 2 ns 且只容許 20 mV 電容放電，C≥100 nF；若有效容量僅標稱的 60%，標稱值至少 167 nF。未含 ESL 過衝與控制迴路。 ΔV=IΔt/C 是初始電荷估算；有效電容、路徑電感與穩壓器響應決定真實瞬態，不能以標稱容量直接保證電源品質。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 1 A load for 2 ns and 20 mV allowed capacitive droop: C≥100 nF. At 60% effective capacitance, nominal capacitance must be at least 167 nF. ESL overshoot and regulator action are excluded. ΔV=IΔt/C is an initial charge estimate; effective capacitance, loop inductance and regulator response govern actual transients.

quiz.question: 在「驗算電荷缺口：反證與驗收」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for check charge deficit: challenge and acceptance?
options: 重算 100 nF 算例，將脈寬加倍並檢查 ΔV 的變化。
並聯越多種容量必定降低所有頻率阻抗
標稱容量就是工作偏壓下容量
optionsEn: Recalculate the 100 nF example, double pulse duration and check the change in ΔV.
Paralleling more values always lowers impedance at every frequency
Nominal capacitance equals capacitance under operating bias
quiz.explanation: 有限電容不能在整個負載事件維持理想電壓，補電時間與初始電壓都必須記錄。 重算 100 nF 算例，將脈寬加倍並檢查 ΔV 的變化。
quiz.explanationEn: Finite capacitance cannot hold ideal voltage throughout a load event; recharge time and initial voltage matter. Recalculate the 100 nF example, double pulse duration and check the change in ΔV.

stages.title: 老化與驗收
stages.description: 本階段處理老化與驗收：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address aging and acceptance through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 測試失效支路
steps.titleEn: Test a failed branch
steps.objective: 建立「測試失效支路」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：一顆電容開路可能移動反共振，短路則屬不同的電源保護問題。

steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。分別移除一條電容支路與加入漏電支路，比較可辨識症狀。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Remove a capacitor branch and separately add leakage; compare distinguishable symptoms. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：分別移除一條電容支路與加入漏電支路，比較可辨識症狀。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Remove a capacitor branch and separately add leakage; compare distinguishable symptoms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：並聯越多種容量必定降低所有頻率阻抗。本步先檢查「測試失效支路」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到一顆電容開路可能移動反共振，短路則屬不同的電源保護問題。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Paralleling more values always lowers impedance at every frequency. First check whether evidence for test a failed branch actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: One open capacitor can move antiresonance; a shorted capacitor is a different protection problem.
steps.check: 交付「測試失效支路」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.objectiveEn: Test the deliver decoupling evidence model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。用相同負載與頻帶比較兩種佈局，不用電容顆數替代結果。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare two layouts under identical load and band, rather than by capacitor count. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：用相同負載與頻帶比較兩種佈局，不用電容顆數替代結果。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare two layouts under identical load and band, rather than by capacitor count. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：標稱容量就是工作偏壓下容量。本步先檢查「交付去耦證據」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到放行資料應包含目標、量測参考面、有效容量、阻抗峰與負載階躍。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Nominal capacitance equals capacitance under operating bias. First check whether evidence for deliver decoupling evidence actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Acceptance evidence needs targets, measurement planes, effective capacitance, impedance peaks and load steps.
steps.check: 交付「交付去耦證據」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for deliver decoupling evidence: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 共封裝電源轉換器
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入共封裝電源的開關損耗、磁性元件與熱路；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine switching loss, magnetics and thermal paths in co-packaged power. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。理想 buck 公式用於教學起點；磁芯非線性、寄生、控制模式與散熱邊界都會改變實際波形。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Ideal buck equations are teaching starting points; magnetic nonlinearity, parasitics, control mode and thermal boundaries alter real waveforms.

stages.title: 功率需求與拓撲
stages.description: 本階段處理功率需求與拓撲：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address power needs and topology through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 分解負載工作模式
steps.titleEn: Separate load operating modes
steps.objective: 建立「分解負載工作模式」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：待機、突發與持續負載對效率和瞬態要求不同，單一滿載數值不足。

steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。建立三種負載佔空比與平均能量表。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Build a table of three load duty cycles and average energy. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：建立三種負載佔空比與平均能量表。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

steps.check: 交付「分解負載工作模式」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 散熱蓋與熱介面材料
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入熱擴散、接觸熱阻與 TIM 厚度；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine heat spreading, contact resistance and tim thickness. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。R=t/(kA) 適用均勻一維導熱；局部熱點、接觸粗糙與擴散電阻須另外處理，不能用材料 k 直接替代整組封裝表現。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. R=t/(kA) assumes uniform one-dimensional conduction; hotspots, rough contact and spreading resistance require additional treatment.

courses.title: 微流道晶片冷卻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微流道對流、壓降、熱點與泵功；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microchannel convection, pressure drop, hotspots and pump power. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。單相穩態水流算例不涵蓋沸騰、氣泡堵塞與冷卻液材料相容性；製作和加壓測試需專業設備。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Single-phase steady-water examples exclude boiling, bubble blockage and coolant compatibility; fabrication and pressurized testing require professional equipment.

stages.descriptionEn: Address thermal-fluid requirements through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

courses.title: 氣密封裝與漏率檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入腔體漏率、滲透與細漏/粗漏；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine cavity leakage, permeation and fine/gross leak tests. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。氦等效漏率不能不經轉換就當成實際空氣或水汽漏率；測試門檻須依腔體容積、氣體及用途設定。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限

Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.

courses.title: 晶圓級真空封裝
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微腔真空、氣體負載與吸氣劑；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microcavity vacuum, gas load and getters. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。P=Q/S 為穩態集中模型；微腔氣體成分、吸附、吸氣容量和封口時間歷史會改變結果。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. P=Q/S is a steady lumped model; gas species, adsorption, getter capacity and sealing history change microcavity behavior.

courses.title: 功率模組銀燒結接合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入銀燒結頸部、孔隙與界面可靠度；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine silver sinter necks, porosity and interface reliability. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。材料廠建議是特定配方的範圍；本課不給通用壓力溫度配方，孔隙率也不能單獨預測疲勞壽命。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Vendor windows apply to specific formulations; no universal pressure-temperature recipe is supplied, and porosity alone does not predict fatigue life.

courses.title: 功率模組雙面散熱

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine double-sided heat sharing, isolation and mechanical constraint. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。兩支路並聯公式假設相同參考溫度及集中熱源；不對稱流體溫度和空間熱點需用完整網路。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Parallel resistance assumes equal reference temperatures and a lumped source; unequal coolants and hotspots need a full network.

courses.title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入DBC 陶瓷絕緣、銅層擴散及邊缘應力；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine dbc insulation, copper heat spreading and edge stress. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。資料表典型 k 和耐壓只適用所列測試條件；DBC、AMB 與薄膜金屬化不可視為同一製程。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Datasheet conductivity and breakdown values apply to stated conditions; DBC, AMB and thin-film metallization are distinct processes.

options: 銅厚與陶瓷厚度一起改變疲勞負荷，不能只比循環次數。

陶瓷耐壓等於整個模組耐壓
optionsEn: Copper and ceramic thickness jointly affect fatigue; cycle counts alone are insufficient.

Ceramic breakdown voltage equals module isolation rating

steps.title: 設計循環比較：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Design cycling comparisons: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「設計循環比較」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the design cycling comparisons model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。保持循環條件，僅改一個幾何變數。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Keep cycling conditions fixed and change one geometric variable. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：保持循環條件，僅改一個幾何變數。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Keep cycling conditions fixed and change one geometric variable. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：陶瓷耐壓等於整個模組耐壓。本步先檢查「設計循環比較」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到銅厚與陶瓷厚度一起改變疲勞負荷，不能只比循環次數。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Ceramic breakdown voltage equals module isolation rating. First check whether evidence for design cycling comparisons actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Copper and ceramic thickness jointly affect fatigue; cycle counts alone are insufficient.
steps.check: 交付「設計循環比較」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for design cycling comparisons: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List validity and non-extrapolation conditions for each candidate. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List validity and non-extrapolation conditions for each candidate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「交付基板選型」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到選型需熱、電、機械及製造相容證據。所指出的物理限制。

steps.check: 交付「交付基板選型」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for deliver substrate selection, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

courses.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入溫度循環歷史、CTE 失配及失效統計；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine thermal-cycle history, cte mismatch and failure statistics. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。加速試驗僅在機制相同時支持外推；零失效不等於無限壽命，環境熱循環與功率循環也不可直接互換。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Accelerated tests support extrapolation only with unchanged mechanisms; zero failures do not imply infinite life, and ambient and power cycling are distinct.

stages.title: 任務與循環
stages.description: 本階段處理任務與循環：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address mission and cycles through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義服役溫度史
steps.titleEn: Define service thermal history
steps.objective: 建立「定義服役溫度史」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define service thermal history: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定義服役溫度史」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for define service thermal history actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.
steps.check: 交付「定義服役溫度史」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入水分擴散、界面剝離與回焊蒸汽壓；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine moisture diffusion, delamination and reflow vapor pressure. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。本課不是 MSL 標準替代品；實際等級、烘烤與回焊條件須依封裝規格及現行標準。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. This course does not replace MSL standards; actual classification, bake and reflow conditions require package specifications and current standards.

courses.title: 焊點疲勞壽命建模
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入焊點蠕變、疲勞能量及模型外推；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine solder creep, fatigue energy and model extrapolation. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。Coffin–Manson 與能量法係數需要材料和試驗校準；本課算例只展示比例敏感度，不產生可保證的服役壽命。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Coffin–Manson and energy-model coefficients require material/test calibration; examples show sensitivity, not guaranteed service life.

options: 外圍焊點常承受較大失配位移，但基板彎曲會改變排序。
所有焊料都可共用同一疲勞常數
線彈性最大應力可完整預測焊料循環壽命
optionsEn: Outer joints often see greater mismatch, but substrate bending can change ranking.
All solders share the same fatigue constants
Peak linear-elastic stress completely predicts solder life
quiz.explanation: 外圍焊點常承受較大失配位移，但基板彎曲會改變排序。 比較中央及角落焊點邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Outer joints often see greater mismatch, but substrate bending can change ranking. Compare center and corner joint boundaries.

steps.title: 辨識中性點距離：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Identify distance to neutral point: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「辨識中性點距離」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the identify distance to neutral point model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較中央及角落焊點邊界。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare center and corner joint boundaries. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較中央及角落焊點邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare center and corner joint boundaries. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：線彈性最大應力可完整預測焊料循環壽命。本步先檢查「辨識中性點距離」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到外圍焊點常承受較大失配位移，但基板彎曲會改變排序。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Peak linear-elastic stress completely predicts solder life. First check whether evidence for identify distance to neutral point actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Outer joints often see greater mismatch, but substrate bending can change ranking.
steps.check: 交付「辨識中性點距離」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for identify distance to neutral point: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.check: 交付「區分應力與應變」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for separate stress and strain, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 套用應變壽命比例

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for apply strain-life scaling: The power-law exponent controls strain sensitivity and needs experimental support.
steps.instruction:

假設 N=C(Δεp)^(-2)，某樣品 Δεp=0.01 時 N=4000；若 Δεp=0.02，比例模型預測 N=1000。指數若為 1.5，則為 1414；模型形式的不確定度顯著。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate the 4000-to-1000 scaling example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

courses.title: 封裝聲學顯微檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入聲阻抗、飛行時間與 C-SAM 界面圖；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine acoustic impedance, time of flight and c-sam interface maps. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。影像亮度取決於閘門、頻率與相位；暗區或亮區不具有普遍固定的缺陷含義，水耦合亦需評估樣品相容性。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Brightness depends on gate, frequency and phase; bright/dark regions have no universal defect meaning, and water coupling requires sample compatibility.

courses.title: 封裝 X 光電腦斷層檢測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入X-ray CT 投影、體素與重建偽影；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine x-ray ct projections, voxels and reconstruction artifacts. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。體素尺寸不等於解析度；CT 未見缺陷不表示界面無裂縫，尤其薄而低對比缺陷須用其他方法交叉驗證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Voxel size is not resolution; absent CT contrast does not prove a crack-free interface, especially for thin low-contrast defects.

stages.descriptionEn: Address projection and absorption through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「理解衰減投影」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the understand attenuation projections model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。用兩個重疊空洞示範投影歧義。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Demonstrate ambiguity with two overlapping voids. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：用兩個重疊空洞示範投影歧義。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Demonstrate ambiguity with two overlapping voids. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：重建亮環一定是材料實體。本步先檢查「理解衰減投影」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到投影整合整條射線的衰減，單張平面圖會重疊深度資訊。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A reconstructed bright ring must be real material. First check whether evidence for understand attenuation projections actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A projection integrates attenuation along a ray and overlaps depth information.
steps.check: 交付「理解衰減投影」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for understand attenuation projections: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.title: 理解衰減投影：機制
knowledge.text: 投影整合整條射線的衰減，單張平面圖會重疊深度資訊。
knowledge.textEn: A projection integrates attenuation along a ray and overlaps depth information.

knowledge.title: 理解衰減投影：證據與判讀

knowledge.text: 用兩個重疊空洞示範投影歧義。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Demonstrate ambiguity with two overlapping voids. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

用兩個重疊空洞示範投影歧義。

steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List two blur sources beyond voxel spacing. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List two blur sources beyond voxel spacing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「分開幾何放大與解析度」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到焦點尺寸、探測器與樣品運動共同限制解析度。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for separate magnification and resolution actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Source size, detector and motion jointly limit resolution.
steps.check: 交付「分開幾何放大與解析度」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for separate magnification and resolution, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 設計角度採樣
steps.titleEn: Design angular sampling
steps.objective: 建立「設計角度採樣」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：投影不足或有限角度可產生方向性偽影。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for design angular sampling: Insufficient or limited-angle views create directional artifacts.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較完整旋轉與受限旋轉假想結果。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare full-rotation and limited-rotation results. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較完整旋轉與受限旋轉假想結果。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「設計角度採樣」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到投影不足或有限角度可產生方向性偽影。所指出的物理限制。

If not, revisit the physical constraint: Insufficient or limited-angle views create directional artifacts.
steps.check: 交付「設計角度採樣」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 矽光子 SOI 波導製作
courses.titleEn: SOI waveguide fabrication for silicon photonics
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SOI 波導侷限、側壁散射與 cutback；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine soi confinement, sidewall scattering and cutback. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。波導尺寸須依實際 PDK；本課不把單一公開截面當成所有代工廠共通設計規則。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Waveguide dimensions must follow the actual PDK; one public cross-section is not a universal foundry rule.

courses.title: 氮化矽低損耗波導
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SiN 低損耗、薄膜應力與吸收頻譜；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine sin low loss, film stress and absorption spectra. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同沉積與退火路徑不可互換；低損耗紀錄屬特定波長與製程，不是所有 SiN 元件的保證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Deposition and annealing routes are not interchangeable; record losses apply to specified wavelength/process, not every SiN device.

courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Effective medium is approximate in a suitable subwavelength, slowly varying regime; near Bragg conditions or discontinuities use full-wave/Bloch analysis.

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「檢查次波長條件」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the check subwavelength regime model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction:
沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。驗算 310 nm 的簡化界限。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。

假設 λ=1550 nm、neff=2.5，簡化一阶 Bragg 週期為 λ/(2neff)=310 nm。選 250 nm 僅表示低於此估值，仍須求解 Bloch 色散及確認整個工作頻帶。
steps.instructionEn:
Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Recalculate the simplified 310 nm boundary. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

For λ=1550 nm and neff=2.5, a simplified first-order Bragg period is 310 nm. A 250 nm period is below this estimate but still needs Bloch dispersion across the operating band.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算 310 nm 的簡化界限。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Recalculate the simplified 310 nm boundary. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：填充比平均折射率永遠精確。本步先檢查「檢查次波長條件」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到導波波長不同於自由空間波長，Bragg 判斷要用模態。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Fill-factor-averaged index is always exact. First check whether evidence for check subwavelength regime actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Guided wavelength differs from free-space wavelength; Bragg checks need the mode.
steps.check: 交付「檢查次波長條件」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for check subwavelength regime: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 光柵耦合器設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入光柵相位匹配、方向性與模場重疊；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine grating phase matching, directionality and modal overlap. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。簡化光柵方程只給初始週期；最佳效率需考慮向下輻射、反射、有限孔徑、偏振與實際纖芯模場。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. The simple grating equation only seeds period; efficiency also depends on downward radiation, reflection, aperture, polarization and fiber fields.

courses.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入邊緣耦合模場展開、端面反射與對準；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine edge-coupler mode expansion, facet reflection and alignment. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。高斯重疊只是近似；實際向量模態、端面角度、空隙與偏振需用完整場解或量測驗證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Gaussian overlap is approximate; vector modes, facet angle, gaps and polarization need field simulation or measurement.

courses.title: 光纖陣列主動對準
courses.summary: 以多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。
workedExample.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch.
workedExample.assumptions: 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

courses.title: 光纖陣列被動對準
courses.summary: 以V 溝幾何基準、纖芯偏心與公差堆疊為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address V-groove datums, core eccentricity and tolerance stacks, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。
workedExample.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term.
workedExample.assumptions: 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

位置分布經非線性耦合函數轉成損耗分布，平均位置不能直接映成平均效率。
平均偏移為零就保證平均損耗為零
optionsEn: A lid fully constrains every degree of freedom
A nonlinear coupling function converts offset to loss; mean position does not give mean efficiency.
Zero mean offset guarantees zero mean loss

steps.title: 結合公差與光學損耗：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Link tolerance to optical loss: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 用結合公差與光學損耗的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of link tolerance to optical loss to distinguish competing explanations.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：將幾個偏移樣本各自轉換損耗，再與平均偏移算例比較。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「平均偏移為零就保證平均損耗為零」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Convert each offset sample to loss and compare with the mean-offset estimate. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Compare prediction with observation and identify direct evidence rejecting "Zero mean offset guarantees zero mean loss" before accepting, remeasuring or revising. Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term.
steps.observation: 將幾個偏移樣本各自轉換損耗，再與平均偏移算例比較。
steps.observationEn: Convert each offset sample to loss and compare with the mean-offset estimate.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「平均偏移為零就保證平均損耗為零」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Zero mean offset guarantees zero mean loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交結合公差與光學損耗的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：將幾個偏移樣本各自轉換損耗，再與平均偏移算例比較。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for link tolerance to optical loss: Convert each offset sample to loss and compare with the mean-offset estimate. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

courses.title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移
courses.titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift
courses.summary: 以光纖膠固化收縮、熱失配與長期黏彈漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Fiber-adhesive cure shrinkage, thermal mismatch and viscoelastic drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。
workedExample.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.textEn: Record position, power and temperature together and mark unexplained residuals. Do not infer: Any cure-time power change must be shrinkage

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
knowledge.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance. Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.

功率變化可能同時來自機械位移與膠折射率變化，要用位置和頻譜交叉判讀。
固化時功率變化只可能是收縮
optionsEn: A fixture ceases to affect position once cure ends
Power changes can combine motion and adhesive-index change; cross-check position and spectra.
Any cure-time power change must be shrinkage
quiz.explanation: 功率變化可能同時來自機械位移與膠折射率變化，要用位置和頻譜交叉判讀。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。

knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input, 0.800 mW desired-port and 0.008 mW leakage power give 20 dB port extinction. Total transmission 0.808 implies 0.926 dB loss. Extinction and total transmission differ; rotation efficiency is not separately determined. Define port power, polarization purity and higher-order modal content separately; total power alone cannot prove TE/TM rotation.

TE 就是任何照片中的水平方向
optionsEn: Reconstruct both input-polarization tests from saved multimode S-parameters.
One peak extinction number is a complete device model
TE always means horizontal in a photograph

courses.title: 多模干涉分光器
courses.summary: 以多模自成像、分光平衡與複數 S 參數為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multimode self-imaging, split balance and complex S-parameters, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 自成像近似只提供初估，需以足夠模態、正確端口和波長掃描驗證；數值收斂與實物校準是不同工作。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.objective: 建立區分分光與損耗的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

steps.instruction: 先標出「區分分光與損耗」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。兩路相加才可估傳輸，單路約一半功率不能直接當作吸收。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。

Sum both outputs to estimate transmission; half power in one branch is not absorption. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters. With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss.

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Evanescent coupling, supermode beating and fabrication tolerance, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm.
workedExample.assumptions: 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 定義波導與間隙：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define guides and gap: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義波導與間隙的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define guides and gap.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義波導與間隙」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。耦合由倏逝場重疊決定，間隙是側壁之間距離而非中心距離。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define guides and gap. Coupling follows evanescent-field overlap; gap means sidewall spacing, not center spacing. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。
steps.observationEn: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「中心距和間隙可以互換使用」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Center spacing and gap are interchangeable" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交定義波導與間隙的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for define guides and gap: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm. The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.

quiz.question: 就「核對三種長度」而言，哪項原理正確？
quiz.questionEn: For distinguish three length scales, which principle is correct?
options: 耦合長度只由總波導長度決定
第一次均分、全轉移和完整拍長相差固定倍數，名稱混用會產生兩倍錯誤。
拍長就是第一次全轉移長度
optionsEn: Coupling is determined only by total guide length
First equal split, full transfer and full beat length differ by fixed factors; confusing them causes factor-two errors.
Beat length equals first full-transfer length
quiz.explanation: 第一次均分、全轉移和完整拍長相差固定倍數，名稱混用會產生兩倍錯誤。 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
quiz.explanationEn: First equal split, full transfer and full beat length differ by fixed factors; confusing them causes factor-two errors. The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.

courses.title: 馬赫曾德爾調變器
courses.summary: 以MZI 相位—強度轉換、偏壓與行波電極為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address MZI phase-to-intensity conversion, bias and traveling-wave electrodes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴.
workedExample.assumptions: 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 定義兩臂與端口：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define arms and ports: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義兩臂與端口的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

steps.instruction: 先標出「定義兩臂與端口」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。輸出是兩臂複數電場相加，能量會分配至互補端口；不能只加功率。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。

steps.observation: 以零相位與 π 相位畫兩端口功率並核對守恆。

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴. The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴. courses.title: 微環調變器
courses.summary: 以微環共振、耦合條件、線寬與調變漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ring resonance, coupling conditions, linewidth and modulation drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical r=10 μm, n_g=4 and λ=1550 nm, circumference is 62.832 μm and local FSR≈9.559 nm. Loaded Q=10000 gives 0.155 nm linewidth. An assumed 80 pm/K drift over 2 K shifts resonance 0.160 nm, about one linewidth.
workedExample.assumptions: FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.objective: 建立判讀臨界耦合的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for interpret critical coupling.
steps.instruction: 先標出「判讀臨界耦合」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。全通環在耦合流出與內部損耗匹配時可有深凹口，但深凹口不是無損。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for interpret critical coupling. An all-pass ring can notch deeply when coupling escape matches internal loss; a deep notch does not imply losslessness. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 同時擬合凹口深度、線寬和相位以區分耦合情況。
steps.observationEn: Fit notch depth, width and phase jointly to distinguish coupling regimes.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「最深凹口必然來自最低內部損耗」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "The deepest notch always means lowest intrinsic loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交判讀臨界耦合的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：同時擬合凹口深度、線寬和相位以區分耦合情況。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for interpret critical coupling: Fit notch depth, width and phase jointly to distinguish coupling regimes. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 全通環在耦合流出與內部損耗匹配時可有深凹口，但深凹口不是無損。
knowledge.textEn: An all-pass ring can notch deeply when coupling escape matches internal loss; a deep notch does not imply losslessness.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 同時擬合凹口深度、線寬和相位以區分耦合情況。 不可推成：最深凹口必然來自最低內部損耗
knowledge.textEn: Fit notch depth, width and phase jointly to distinguish coupling regimes. Do not infer: The deepest notch always means lowest intrinsic loss

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。 FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical r=10 μm, n_g=4 and λ=1550 nm, circumference is 62.832 μm and local FSR≈9.559 nm. Loaded Q=10000 gives 0.155 nm linewidth. An assumed 80 pm/K drift over 2 K shifts resonance 0.160 nm, about one linewidth. FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.

quiz.question: 就「判讀臨界耦合」而言，哪項原理正確？
quiz.questionEn: For interpret critical coupling, which principle is correct?
options: 全通環在耦合流出與內部損耗匹配時可有深凹口，但深凹口不是無損。
最深凹口必然來自最低內部損耗
雙峰一定代表兩個不同大小的環
optionsEn: An all-pass ring can notch deeply when coupling escape matches internal loss; a deep notch does not imply losslessness.
The deepest notch always means lowest intrinsic loss
A doublet always means two different rings

FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。 FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。

courses.title: 鍺光偵測器整合
courses.summary: 以Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction.
workedExample.assumptions: 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 分別測暗態噪聲、受光噪聲及電子背景，保持相同頻寬。 不可推成：只知道暗電流就能算出全部接收噪聲
knowledge.textEn: Measure dark, illuminated and electronic noise at common bandwidth. Do not infer: Dark current alone determines all receiver noise

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

courses.title: 鍺矽雪崩光偵測器
courses.summary: 以Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想單位增益光電流 I₀=5 μA、M=10，平均乘增光電流 50 μA。電子注入局部模型取 k=β/α=0.10（電洞／電子游離係數比），F=kM+(1−k)(2−1/M)=2.71；初級光電流散粒噪聲的單邊功率譜密度為 2qI₀M²F，不是只乘 M。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical unity-gain photocurrent I₀=5 μA and M=10, mean multiplied current is 50 μA. An electron-injection local model with k=β/α=0.10 (hole/electron ionization ratio) gives F=kM+(1−k)(2−1/M)=2.71. Primary photocurrent shot-noise one-sided PSD is 2qI₀M²F, not merely multiplied by M.
workedExample.assumptions: 此例採線性模式、均勻局部游離與電子注入近似；薄乘增層的非局部效應、混合注入、暗電流和電路噪聲另算。提高平均增益不能單獨證明 SNR 改善。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: This assumes linear mode, uniform local ionization and electron injection. Nonlocal effects in thin multiplication regions, mixed injection, dark current and circuit noise are separate. Mean gain alone does not establish improved SNR.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms.
workedExample.assumptions: 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.

courses.title: 載子耗盡相位調變
courses.summary: 以反向接面耗盡、複數折射率與電光限制為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Reverse-junction depletion, complex index and electro-optic limits, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth.
workedExample.assumptions: Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。 Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth. Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.

places.summary: 以公開光子研發與封裝機構為地理代表，討論多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移如何由單一元件走向可量測、可封裝的系統。地圖沿用本學院矽光子課程的代表據點，並非此技術唯一發源地或所有文獻實驗位置。
places.summaryEn: A public photonic research/packaging institution provides geographic context for translating Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift from a component into a measurable packaged system. The map uses the academy’s silicon-photonics reference location, not the sole invention site or every cited laboratory.

history.title: 從元件演示到可重現介面
history.titleEn: From component demonstration to reproducible interfaces
history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.
